balls.text: full outside off. Deshpande, rather ambitiously, looks for the reverse-lap and misses. Theekshana takes on Dhoni's arm and manages to sneak in a single. RR finish with 182!
full just outside off. Theekshana drives it down the ground to mid off and scampers across to the other end
another zipping yorker, right under the bat and following the batter outside leg. Theekshana cannot do much with it and no problems with collection for Dhoni this time
back of a length delivery well outside leg. Deshpande does not get bat on it and Dhoni cannot gather cleanly either, which allows RR to pinch another run
in-swinging yorker on leg stump. Theekshana jams down on it and squirts it off the inside edge towards deep backward square leg
full and wide. Deshpande throws his hands at it and slices it on the bounce to sweeper cover. That was in the air for a while but Tripathi could not get there

oh my - that is going to bring down rain! Goes very, very high, and Ashwin snaffles it up! Fullish on middle and off. Hetmyer looks to go downtown but like Archer in the previous over, cuts across it too much. Only gets height and no distance, with Ashwin, back-pedaling from extra cover, doing the rest!

that is a wild, wild delivery to start off. Almost on the adjacent strip to the right and Dhoni does well to get something behind it. A quick check to see if it is a No ball, but the umpire, after consultation, signals a wide

enormous lbw shout, and Khaleel has another! But hang on, Theekshana has reviewed! Zipped in full again, finishing on middle and leg. Theekshana, sitting deep in his crease, has an agricultural swipe at it and misses. Gets pinned on the back leg and that seems to be heading into the stumps. Only question is if this pitched outside leg. And that is indeed the case. Ball Tracking shows the ball to be pitching just outside leg, and Theekshana survives!

oh dear - that is a terrible mix-up, and Khaleel has run Kartikeya out! Excellent yorker just outside off. Hetmyer jams it into his pad and takes off for the single. Kartikeya is not expecting that and he hesitates, perhaps even having a mid-pitch conversation with his partner in between. Khaleel picks the ball up and runs towards the stumps, catching the batter just short of his ground. CSK keep chipping away!
dug into the track outside off. Kartikeya gets up on his toes and slashes it down to deep third

Archer wants a piece of the action too, but he is caught at long on, after a bit of a bobble! Right in the slot outside off. Archer winds up and has a huge swing at it. Slices across it too much, though, and Gaikwad, running around to his left, despite a couple of bobbles, holds on!
angled in on a length on middle and leg. Hetmyer clears his front leg and heaves it towards deep square leg
Hetmyer goes massive over the leg side! Into his arc on middle and leg. Hetmyer bends his back knee to get under it completely and mauls it over deep backward square leg!
full and wide outside off. Just beyond the tramlines and called a wide. CSK happy to not review that. Seemed touch-and-go, but leaning more towards being a wide
full outside off. Archer gets a half stride in and pokes it down the ground towards mid off. A one-run over in the 18th, and that just speaks volumes of Pathirana's death-bowling quality!

smashes timbbbbberrrrrr this time, and the RR captain is on his way! Searing in-swinging yorker and Pathirana is doing his thing in Guwahati. Parag swipes at it, perhaps trying to go too square and misses the ball completely. Hears the death rattle soon after, and the RR skipper has to go, with just a little more than two overs remaining!

ouch - that will not tickle one bit! Banged into the track on middle and off. Parag looks for the pull but is awfully rushed on the stroke, with the ball then smashing him near the right forearm, towards the elbow. He calls for assistance straightaway and that looks like a very punishing blow
oh, how has that missed?! Almost a yorker, tailing in towards off stump. Parag has a wild yahoo across the line and is lucky his off stump is not pegged back
full just outside off. Hetmyer looks to go downtown and ends up edging it to deep third
very full outside off. Hetmyer throws his hands at it but cannot muster the power he is after. Clinks it straight to mid off
fired in full outside off. Hetmyer gets a big stride in and turns it towards deep mid wicket
googly on a length on leg stump. Turns back in sharply and Hetmyer, who was trying to read it off the pitch, is late on the flick. Trickles off his pads into the on side
googly bowled fuller on middle and leg. Parag nudges it behind point and is happy with a single
leg-spinner on a length on leg stump. Spins back into Parag and he gets beaten on the inside to get rapped on the front pad. Impact well outside leg, though
fetch that too, says Riyan Parag! Right in the slot outside off. Parag lines it up early, clears his front leg and clubs it a mile over wide long on!
shot! Fizzed in on a length just outside off. Parag shapes for the reverse and swats it over backward point. Top, top shot!
another slice of fortune for Hetmyer! Off-cutter on a back of a length on leg stump. Hetmyer stabs at it and squirts it off the inside edge past short fine leg!
fullish on middle and off. Zips off the surface and Parag chunks it off the inside half of the bat towards deep mid wicket
yorker outside off. Hetmyer digs it out towards mid off and then calls for the single. Has to hustle but gets there in the end
length ball just outside leg. Hetmyer looks to help it fine but is a little late on the stroke. Brushes the pad and is then stopped by Dhoni diving to his right

goes straight up, and goes straight down! Overton the guilty party! Off-pace on a full length on middle and leg. Hetmyer has a huge swing at it and gets plenty of height. No distance, though, but fortunately for him, Overton, running in from long on, makes a complete mess of it. Goes straight through
full outside off. Hetmyer gets decent purchase on his off-drive but cannot get it past the fielder at mid off
back of a length outside off. Hetmyer eases it down the ground towards long off
pushed in on a length on leg stump. Parag nudges it behind square towards short fine leg
shortish just outside off and Hetmyer will feel he has missed out there. Hacks it towards deep mid wicket and lets out a grunt of frustration
back of a length on middle stump. Spins away a touch and Parag accounts for it, working it towards deep mid wicket
back of a length on off. Hetmyer goes back and punches it towards long on to get off the mark

oh wow, what has happened to CSK all of a sudden! They could catch a cold in the desert the way they have been fielding these last few minutes! Darted in full on leg stump. Hasaranga gives himself room, trying to slog it over cow corner. Shanks it, though, and hits it flat towards deep mid wicket. Vijay Shankar watches the ball like a hawk and then sprawls forward to pick it up centimetres off the turf. A proper worldie, and CSK have their fifth wicket!
googly on a full length on middle and off. Hasaranga drives uppishly but places it enough to the bowler's left. Single to long off
back of a length outside off. Parag pushes it out towards sweeper cover
back of a length wide outside off. Left alone by Parag and called a wide
shortish outside off. Hasaranga hops back and cuts it towards deep point
back of a length just outside off. Hasaranga goes deep into his crease and cuts it behind point for a couple of runs
googly fizzed through on a length just outside off. Hasaranga has a big waft at it first up and is beaten by the spin

has Pathirana taken that?! It will be a stunning grab if he has! Googly on a fullish length outside off. Plenty of revs on this and the ball dips late on Jurel. He hacks at it and skews it off the outside half of the bat. Pathirana tracks it from backward point and lunges forward at the very last moment to scoop it up inches off the turf. There was a bit of a bobble too but Pathirana did enough to cling on. CSK have two wickets in quick succession!
full and wide outside off. Parag reaches out for it and drills it past backward point. Noor makes up ground on the fence, slides to his left and reins it in
back of a length on the pads. Jurel uses the angle and helps it into the square leg region
shortish on leg stump. Parag lets the ball come to him before tucking it off his pads towards deep mid wicket
slanted in on a length on leg stump. Jurel backs away and drives it on the up towards long off
fuller on middle and off. Jurel plays it back to the bowler
darted in on middle and leg. Jurel hangs back and prods it towards the bowler

oh dear - that is sloppy! Bowled with a similar action to the last ball, full just outside off. Parag powers it towards long off, where Ravindra makes a meal of it. Ashwin will not be amused with that!
a slightly different bowling action for this, fired in full on off. Jurel knocks it down the ground and gets off the mark
carrom ball bowled from wide of the crease. Full outside off and Jurel pushes it towards extra cover

Ashwin outwits Rana. Finally. But Rana has done plenty of damage to CSK already! Ashwin pauses and then spears it way outside off, after seeing Rana advance slightly early. Rana cannot reach it in the end and Dhoni is on the same wavelength as his bowler. He collects and then takes off the bails, with Rana stranded well outside his crease. Ashwin leaps into the air in celebration, and it is fair to say he enjoyed that. A superlative knock comes to an end, but it has put RR on course for 200 and beyond!
Rana is toying with CSK now! Low full toss just outside off. Rana brings out the reverse and nails it between backward point and short third!
Rana continues to plunder the CSK attack! In the slot again, angling into off stump. Rana gets down on one knee and muscles it just over the wide long on fence!
carrom ball on a back of a length on leg stump. Parag tucks it off his pads towards deep mid wicket
into the blockhole just outside off. Parag jams down on it and squeezes it out towards backward point
slower ball on a full length on middle and leg. Rana does not pick it and plays it too early, chipping it towards mid wicket
back of a length just outside off. Parag stands up on his toes and flat-bats it towards long on
shortish outside off. Parag waits on it and uses the pace to run it down to deep third. Khaleel goes down in instalments but does enough to stop the boundary
another wayward delivery, well down leg. Dhoni does well to get something behind it but that will be another extra to RR's total
excellent comeback. Pin-point yorker on off. Parag spots it early enough but cannot do much with it. Defended into the off side
serious whippage and watch that white ball fly! In the slot on the pads and Parag does not miss out. Snaps his wrists into action and whips it over deep square leg!
speared down leg first up. Parag gets nowhere near it and the umpire has no qualms in calling it a wide
fullish just outside off. Parag reaches out for it and tugs it towards deep mid wicket
googly on a back of a length on off. Spins back in, tucks Rana for room and he shanks his slog-sweep towards deep mid wicket
another beautiful inside-out shot! Floated up full and wide, and Rana takes full toll. Complete extension of the arms and he crashes it over extra cover!
on a length on middle and leg. Parag drops it into the off side and saunters across to the other end
another googly, on a back of a length and pitching on middle stump. Spins away sharply and breezes past Parag's flailing blade
googly on a length just outside off. Parag does not read it and goes feeling for it, only to be beaten on the outside comprehensively
brilliant shot to end the over! Bowled with a pause and with a bit of air, on a full length just outside off. Rana gives himself room and caresses it over extra cover!
pushed in again, on a length on middle and off. Rana lunges forward and defends
back of a length, angling into off stump. Rana pokes it back to the bowler, after getting caught on the crease

massive lbw shout, and Ashwin has gotten the better of Nitish Rana! Or has he? Rana goes upstairs straightaway! Slanted in very full on middle and leg. Rana, like he did in Ashwin's first over, looks for the sweep but plays all over it this time. Was it going down? Did Rana hit it? Let's see what the replays tell us. There are murmurs on UltraEdge but also a gap between the bat and ball. No bat involved, says the third umpire. Onto Ball Tracking now...and it reckons the ball would have slid past leg stump. Rana stays, and Ashwin will have to wait for a wicket!
another carrom ball, on a back of a length on middle and leg. Parag helps it into the on side
carrom ball on a back of a length on middle and off. Straightens off the surface and Parag prods it back to the bowler
googly fizzed through on a length just outside off. Rips back in sharply, beats Rana on the inside and raps him on the pad. Going down leg, though
tossed up full just outside off. Parag lunges forward and pushes it towards long off to get off the mark
into the blockhole on middle and off. Parag digs it out towards extra cover with minimal fuss

straight to long off, and Noor does what he has been doing all season: pick wickets! Floated up a little more, on a fullish length outside off. Samson looks to go downtown but cannot get under it enough. Arrows it flat to long off, and Rachin Ravindra makes no mistake. Some respite for CSK and a much-needed breakthrough!
another googly, on a fullish length just outside off. Rana lunges forward and works it towards deep square leg
googly on a full length on middle and off. Samson drives it down the ground to long off
pushed in on a length on the pads. Rana looks to glance it fine but cannot beat short fine leg. A five-run over for Ashwin after a 19-run opening over
darted in full on the pads. Samson tucks it away towards deep square leg
bowled with a pause, on a length on middle and leg. Rana pokes it down the ground to long on
length on middle and leg. Eased out to deep mid wicket
back of a length on the stumps. Rana lets the ball come to him before knocking it to deep mid wicket
sticks to that line on the pads. On a length this time and Samson works it towards deep mid wicket
high and handsome! Rana is sparing no one now! Slower ball dug into the track outside off. Sits up nicely for Rana and he clobbers it a mile over deep mid wicket!

up and over, and Rana blazes away to a 21-ball half-century! Just a touch short and offering Rana enough width. He chases after it and flays it over backward point. Plenty of applause from the dugout, and this has been a stunning counter-attacking knock!
back of a length outside off. Rana gets on top of the bounce and pushes it towards backward point
back of a length just outside off. Rana goes deep into his crease and taps it into the off side
streaky but guess what, they all count! Short and wide, giving Rana the chance to throw his hands at it. He gets a bit of a bottom-edge but that flies away past Dhoni!
shortish on leg stump. Samson waits in his crease and turns it towards mid wicket
fired in full on the pads again. Samson eases it out to deep mid wicket
full on the pads. Rana is happy to nudge it into the mid wicket region and pick up a single
four more! Ashwin looks for the leg-stump yorker and errs on the fuller side. Rana, of course, capitalizes. He gets down on the sweep and helps it through square leg!

in the air, and beyond the fence again! Ashwin pauses before delivering this but the result is still the same. Rana sweeps this length ball on the stumps out of sight, and he might have hit the car podium with that one!
Rana welcomes Ashwin with a maximum! Darted in full and on the pads. Rana gets down on one knee early and sweeps it over the deep backward square leg fence!
seems like a carrom ball on a length on middle and leg. Samson knocks it down the ground to long on
back of a length on leg stump. Samson hops up onto his toes and tucks it off his hips towards deep square leg

what a shot that is! This short-ball barrage is not working for Overton, and he has not made the correction yet. Samson picks the length early, opens up his front hip and demolishes it over mid wicket!
yorker on the pads. Rana jams down on it and tucks it off his toes towards deep square leg
crafty, crafty batting! Dug into the track on middle and leg. Rana watches it till the last moment and then arches his back to upper-cut it over the keeper's head!
on a length on leg stump. Rana gets a half stride in and defends
Rana is on the charge! This is short again and also outside leg, which is asking for trouble with fine leg up. Rana gets inside the line and helps it over the fielder!

back of a length on the hips. Samson uses the pace on offer and clips it beautifully through square leg. Pathirana tries to channel his inner Premier League footballer with a leg-first slide but cannot quite prevent the boundary!
length ball on the pads. Samson sits deep in his crease and flicks it on the bounce to mid wicket
back of a length, pitching just outside leg and finishing on the stumps. Samson, caught on the crease, plays all over it to get rapped on the pads
back of a length outside off. Rana waits for it and then opens his bat face to guide it to deep third. Pathirana nearly over-ran that
much fuller on middle and leg. Samson pokes it towards mid off and calls for the single early. Makes it very comfortably in the end
back of a length on middle and leg. Samson gets behind the line and plays it back to the bowler
another short ball, just outside off. Rana looks to hack it across the line and only connects with the fresh Guwahati air

through the hands, and Rana has his first maximum! Shortish again, angling across the batter outside off. Rana throws the kitchen sink at it and Khaleel is very interested at deep third. He jumps up but cannot clasp his hands on time. Flicks the finger and clears the rope!
miscued but safe! Banged into the track just outside off. Rana has a swipe across the line and splices it because of the extra bounce. Plonks it over mid wicket and bags a brace

full and swinging into the pads. Rana rolls his wrists nicely and clips it behind square. Pathirana gives chase from fine leg but the ball has just enough on it to beat him to the fence, despite a slide!
back of a length just outside off. Samson gets up on his toes and dabs it enough to backward point's left to get off the mark
dug into the track on leg stump. Rana lets the ball come to him before helping it down to fine leg

back of a length outside off. Moves away a touch and then wobbles away an even greater deal after beating Rana on the cut. Lands on the half-volley, just in front of Dhoni and he fumbles his collection, allowing a bye
Rana off the mark with a boundary too! Khaleel goes searching and bowls it too full outside off. Rana opens his bat face and threads it between point and backward point!
full toss outside off and that takes Rana by surprise. He cannot make contact and ends up wafting at thin air

chipped in the air and Ashwin gobbles it up! Khaleel issues a fiery send-off, and he has another early breakthrough this season! On a length outside off and this seems to just stick in the surface a little. Jaiswal tries to drive on the up but cannot get on top of it. Pops it straight to Ashwin at mid off, and he makes absolutely no mistake. CSK on the board early, and Jaiswal's indifferent start to the season continues!
back of a length, just outside off. A bit of shape back in and Jaiswal, pressing half forward, taps it down the ground
wow, what a way to get the innings going! Half-volley outside off and this swings in beautifully into the slot. Jaiswal goes through the line and cracks it past extra cover!

hoicked across to deep backward square leg, and that is the end of this crazy, crazy game of cricket! Rajasthan Royals win by six runs, and they are now on the board! And amidst a sea of yellow, which turned up at what should be RR's home ground, the hosts have held their nerve and they have come up trump, against a team known historically for coming up clutch! Off-pace on a back of a length wide outside off. Overton gives it everything he has and mows it into the on side. Just a brace, though, and that is not nearly enough for CSK. They now lose two in a row and they will be gutted with how the final few moments of this game panned out!

in the air and that has been fielded on the fence! Overton cannot produce a boundary and RR can touch it now! Slower bumper outside off. Overton swipes at it and heaves it towards deep backward square leg. Just a brace, and that should be that for CSK tonight!
oh, hello! Oh, hello! Sandeep misses the yorker by a smidgen on the shorter side and gets pumped over his head. Clean swing through the line and that has kept CSK breathing!
very full outside off. Jadeja cannot get under this either and he powers it straight to long off. CSK cannot smuggle a second either. Good work by Jaiswal on the fence
full on middle and off. Overton cannot get under it and he drills it down the ground towards long off

has Hetmyer taken it on the fence?! He might just have, and CSK hearts sink with that dismissal! An outstanding catch, right out of the top drawer when RR needed it most! And there will be no finishing act from the great man tonight! Low full toss just outside off. Dhoni tugs at it with his strong wrists but cannot get it enough to Hetmyer's left at deep mid wicket. He scampers across, dives forward and then gobbles it up just inches off the turf. What a huge moment in the game, and what a piece of fielding to possibly win it for RR!
banged into the track and this sails over the batter's head. Dhoni lets it go and that has been called a wide for height

Jadeja goes into the stands now, and CSK are still alive! Back of a length outside off and Jadeja telegraphs it. He moves across his stumps and then sweeps Deshpande over the deep backward square leg fence!
slower bumper outside off and that meddles with Dhoni's timing. He has a swipe at it and shanks it towards deep backward square leg for a single
bang! Dhoni goes into the sightscreen (almost)! Off-pace on a back of a length outside off and this sits up for Dhoni. He picks the variation early and slams it over the bowler's head!
nails the wide yorker and takes it outside Jadeja's arc. He tries to slog-sweep but can only clink it towards deep mid wicket
slower ball hung up on a length wide outside off. Dhoni swings at it with all his might and drags it towards deep mid wicket. Just a single. Over to Jadeja
short, wide and Dhoni punishes it! Seems like a change-up too, and Dhoni just hops up onto his toes before letting his fast hands do the work. Slashed over short third for four!
low full toss outside off. Dhoni gets his hands through the ball and powers it down the ground to long off. Just a single, though, and CSK's task is getting a lot tougher
full toss outside off and Dhoni misses out, would you believe it! Drills it straight to extra cover and that is a big missed opportunity
right into the blockhole outside off. Jadeja cannot do much with it and digs it out into the off side
very full on leg stump. Dhoni tucks it off his toes towards deep mid wicket. Just a single, though
back of a length on off. Jadeja bunts it into the vast open spaces on the mid wicket region and looks for two. But that was not quite on
shortish just outside off. Jadeja gives himself a bit of room and cuts it through backward point for a couple of runs
low full toss just outside off. Jadeja swings hard at it and tugs it towards long on. Nine off the over and RR will take that with both hands!
back of a length on middle and off. Keeps a little low and Dhoni jabs it towards extra cover for another single
full just outside off. Jadeja plants his front foot and drives it down the ground towards long on
hard length just outside off. Dhoni dabs it towards backward point and canters across to the other end, despite Archer trying to catch him out at the non-striker's
slower bumper outside off. Jadeja jumps up onto his toes and swats it towards deep mid wicket
splits the field perfectly! Shortish outside off and this sits up a touch for Jadeja. He waits on it and then plays it very late, steering it between backward point and short third!
leg-spinner on a length outside off. Dhoni takes a step down the track and then via a combination of bat and pad, defends

taken on the fence, and Hasaranga performs yet another magic trick on the night, and yet another Pushpa celebration! Slowed up even more and hung up wider outside off. Gaikwad looks to repeat the dose but he has to drag it. Gaikwad toe-ends it completely and Jaiwal at long on makes no mistake whatsoever! Gaikwad bites the dust with a little more than four overs left, and RR may just have nudged ahead in this contest!
but Gaikwad spoils it momentarily! Staggering blow under pressure! On a length on middle and off. Gaikwad drops down to one knee and clubs it over deep mid wicket!
flighted up on a length on middle and off. Jadeja scuffs his sweep and settles for a single behind square on the leg side
back of a length outside off. Jadeja reads it off the pitch but can only dab it straight to backward point
googly tossed up wonderfully outside off. Jadeja reaches out for it but canot get to it. Spins past the outside edge
yorker that follows Gaikwad outside leg. He squeezes it out and hits it with just enough pace to take on the sweeper on the deep on the off side and scuttle back for two

slower bumper that gets big on Gaikwad and slides just a little down leg. Gaikwad cannot get over it and seems to swipe at thin air. Jadeja wanted to pinch the bye but Gaikwad was not as interested. Could CSK have reviewed that for a wide on height?
another short ball on off. Jadeja gets up on his toes and pulls it straight to deep mid wicket. A few yards either side and that might have hit the fence
short and way outside off again. Jadeja lets it go and the umpire has to indulge in more exercise
flayed away! Wide low full toss and Jadeja throws the kitchen sink at it. Gets a bit of an outside edge and that flies past short third!
banged into the track outside off. Jadeja reaches out for it and hacks it towards deep mid wicket. Back for a quick brace
short and wide, but Jadeja cannot make it count. Dabs it straight to backward point and he will be disappointed with that attempt
back of a length delivery bowled a mile outside off. Left alone by Jadeja and called a wide

very full outside off. Gaikwad opens his bat face slightly and guides it enough to sweeper cover's right to bag another brace. 12 off the over, which is what CSK need for the rest of their innings too
full outside off. Gaikwad unfurls the slog-sweep now and nearly finds the gap between deep mid wicket and long on. Good work by Hetmyer to save two
fullish just outside off. Jadeja has a stab at it and chunks it off the inside half of the bat towards deep mid wicket
low full toss, angling into off stump. Driven out to sweeper cover
back of a length on leg stump. Gaikwad hangs back and punches it towards long on, and this time, the batters opt to take the second. Fifty up for Gaikwad, and this has been a solid knock so far!
shot! Fired in on a length just outside off. Gaikwad reads the length early, gets down on one knee and hammers it behind square!
very full on middle and leg. Gaikwad clinks his drive and the ball trickles down to long on. Just six singles off that over, and that amps up the pressure on CSK
shortish and following Jadeja outside leg. He tucks it away towards deep backward square leg
low full toss on leg stump. Gaikwad flicks it towards deep mid wicket
back of a length just outside off. Jadeja jams it into the pitch and the ball bounces up over Sandeep's head, which prevents what could have been a bad mix-up between the batters
back of a length just outside off. Gaikwad opens up his stance and tugs it to long on's right for a single
back of a length just outside off. Holds a little in the surface as Jadeja punches it off the back foot towards long on
back of a length on middle and off. Jadeja goes back and works it towards deep square leg to get off the mark

does him all ends up with a corker! Vijay Shankar had no clue about that one! This is world-class bowling. Tosses this up, and hangs it in the air agonizingly on a length just outside off. Shankar goes reaching out for it in front and leaves a big gap between bat and pad. The ball bursts through and knocks over his stumps. Hasaranga has his third, and CSK lose another!
Shankar lands his first punch and it is a brutal one! Googly floated up into the slot on the stumps. Shankar picks the variation and slog-sweeps it powerfully over deep mid wicket!
tossed up full on leg stump. Gaikwad stretches forward and drives it to long on
fizzed in on a length on middle and leg. Gaikwad reads the leg-spinner off the pitch and defends
back of a length just outside off. Shankar goes back and glances it towards short fine leg

Gaikwad finishes the over the way he started it: with a boundary! This is again on the shorter side and Gaikwad does not miss out. Uses the depth of the crease and pounds it to deep mid wicket's right!
beauty! Back of a length, just outside off. Gaikwad does not know whether to come forward or stay back, and sees the ball sneak past the outside edge
googly on a length on middle and off. Gaikwad gets caught on the crease and defends in the end
back of a length on middle stump. Shankar goes back and tugs it towards deep backward square leg
this is an even bigger drag-down but the lack of pace means Gaikwad cannot cash in. He drags it towards deep backward square leg
scorched across the turf! Dragged down on middle and off. Gaikwad rocks back and pummels it to beat long on to his right!
back of a length just outside off. Gaikwad goes back and taps it towards deep point to keep strike
back of a length on the stumps. Shankar goes back and works it towards deep mid wicket
the googly comes and it nearly takes out Vijay Shankar's off stump! Nicely tossed up, on a length just outside off. Shankar goes searching for it and is cut in half

oh my word - put a cape on Riyan Parag! That is a worldie and a half! Hasaranga floats it up outside off and angles it across Dube. He tries to go inside-out but cannot keep it down, nor can he get under it completely. Parag flings himself forward to his right and seems to get his right hand under it. Looks touch-and-go, but Parag might have gotten his right mitt under it. The third umpire agrees with that assessment, and Dube has to go! What a moment in this game!
that is an enormous hit! Slower and much fuller outside off, which means it is also in Dube's arc. He bends his back knee and smokes the living daylights out of this one, over wide long on!
Dube begins after the time-out with a boundary! A slight drag-down on middle and off. Dube picks the length early, hops back and hoicks it to deep backward square leg's right!
back of a length on leg stump. Dube tucks it off his pads towards deep square leg
full outside off. Driven out to sweeper cover for another single
back of a length outside off. Dube stands tall and punches it powerfully past extra cover. The sweeper cuts it off and CSK take just the single. That is not great running
huge lbw shout, not given! Back of a length delivery that skids off the surface and finishes on leg stump. Dube is rapped on the pads but that may have pitched outside leg
back of a length on leg stump. Gaikwad lets the ball come to him before easing it to long on
edged and four! No slip for Theekshana and that is exactly where the ball goes. Gaikwad pokes at this fullish ball in the channel and gets a thick outside edge. Gets four for his toil!
fuller and wider outside off. Dube gets onto the front foot and pushes it towards extra cover
googly on a length just outside off. Dube is unsure of where this is spinning and edges it towards short third
Dube goes big early and of course he clears long on! Floated up full on off and Dube needs no second invitation. He swings through the line and launches it!
tossed up full outside off. Gaikwad stretches forward and knocks it to long off
angled in on a length on leg stump. Dube comes forward and helps it into the on side. Not sure if that was off the bat, though. Off the pad, says the umpire

Hasaranga into the wicket-taking act straightaway! Shortish on off and that seems to just hold in the surface a little. Tripathi looks to pull it away but the lack of pace means he arrows it towards deep mid wicket. Hetmyer hurtles around to his right and then dives forward to complete a sharp catch. RR break this partnership, and they will be pleased Hasaranga has a wicket early!
very full on middle and leg. Tripathi digs it out towards extra cover and retains strike
length just outside off. Tripathi looks for the reverse but scuffs it off the glove towards short third. Wanted the single too but was sent back in time
back of a length on the stumps. Gaikwad eases it out to deep mid wicket
back of a length on off. Tripathi backs away and dabs it towards deep point
carrom ball on a shortish length on leg stump. Gaikwad swivels and pulls it on the bounce to deep backward square leg
fired in full on off. Gaikwad gets onto the front foot and pats it gently back towards the bowler
very full outside off. Gaikwad tips it to mid off and hurtles across to the other end. Cops the fielder's throw for his troubles but that is good hustle nevertheless
four more! This is another loose delivery. An attempted leg-stump yorker that ends up being a low full toss outside leg. Gaikwad uses his wrists and flicks it past short fine leg!
off-pace on a back of a length outside off. Gaikwad has a hack across the line and misses it completely. That did not bounce a great deal either
that is another cracking shot! Shortish outside off and sitting up to be hit. Gaikwad gets on top of the bounce and crrrrrrrrunnnnnnnchhhhhessss it between extra cover and cover point!
class written all over that! On a back of a length on middle and off. Gaikwad gets down on one knee early and belts it behind square. One bounce and into the fence!
back of a length just outside off. Tripathi backs away and chops it towards cover for a single
full outside off. Tripathi, sitting deep in his crease, tugs it enough to mid on's right and keeps strike
searing yorker, just outside off. Tripathi picks it a touch late but jams his bat down just in time. Squeezes it out past leg stump and towards the keeper
four more! Not great bowling by Archer, it must be said. This is a half-tracker outside leg and all Tripathi has to do is get bat on it!
Tripathi goes all the way now! 14 runs off his last four balls! Leg-cutter on a back of a length on middle and off. Tripathi shimmies across, gets inside the line and heaves it over fine leg!

Archer pleads for an lbw, but Adrian Holdstock says no! Length just outside off. Tripathi moves across, plays all around it and gets rapped on the pads. Impact might have been outside the line, though
back of a length just outside off. Gaikwad has a nibble at it and jams it off the inside edge into his pads. The ball rolls away for a single towards point

back to back boundaries now! This is banged in shorter outside off. Tripathi goes the other way now and shuffles across to help it past short fine leg. Might have been off the glove but Tripathi will not mind one bit!

gets bat to ball finally, and finds the fence too! Shortish and hung up wide outside off. Tripathi, having backed away, does well to reach it and the ball flies off the bottom half of the bat, beating deep third to his right!
shortish and sliding just down leg. Tripathi does not get bat on it, despite trying to help it fine, and that will be another dot. Might have been a change-up too
banged into the track outside off. Tripathi hares down the track and then has a wild swipe across the line. Only swats away a few flies
shortish on leg stump. Gaikwad rises with the bounce and punches it neatly through mid wicket. Has enough time to get back for three as well
length outside off and this shapes away nicely. Gaikwad is drawn into a drive and then beaten by the late movement
jaffa! Back of a length in the channel. Zips back in sharply and cuts Tripathi in half. He had no clue about that!

big appeal for a caught-behind, not given! Banged into the track and this slides just outside leg. Tripathi, stood deep in his crease, has a pop at it and seems to miss it. Keeper and bowler were very interested, but they decide not to review. Not called a wide either, so maybe they have saved the wide with that appeal!
full outside off. Tripathi moves a mile across his stumps and then looks to power it downtown. Only grabs a handful of fresh air
shortish on the hips. Gaikwad eases it past square leg and picks up a single
back of a length on leg stump. Gaikwad gets up on his toes and tucks it off his hips towards square leg. Good work by Hetmyer to stop the single
back of a length on middle and off. Gaikwad gets behind the line and pats it gently back to the bowler
into the blockhole on middle and leg. Tripathi shimmies around his crease before settling outside leg. Digs it out towards backward point eventually
back of a length on leg stump. Gaikwad stabs it towards mid on and canters across to the other end
fuller outside off and Gaikwad comes forward confidently. Punches it towards extra cover, who gets a hand to it and takes the verve out of the stroke. Gaikwad gets two for his troubles

ouch - Gaikwad cops a blow on the right forearm now! Dug into the track on middle and off. Gaikwad looks for the pick-up pull but misses the ball completely. The ball does not miss his forearm, though, and he looks in plenty of pain. That seemed to be closer to the elbow than Parag's blow and might have hit him near the bone. That will sting!
full just outside off. Moves away again and does so late. Gaikwad presses forward and defends
back of a length outside off. A bit of shape away and Tripathi uses that to run it down to deep third
back of a length outside off. Gaikwad gets up on his toes and jabs it towards backward point. Archer begins with a maiden!
banged into the track outside off. Gaikwad gauges it early enough and ducks under it comfortably

nicked and gone! CSK lose a wicket early again, and Archer is absolutely pumped! Back of a length outside off. Ravindra continues wafting and this time, Archer finds the outside edge he is after. Flies through to Jurel, who completes the catch and that is Archer's first wicket this season. A huge moment in the game early, and Archer seems fired up for the contest!
back of a length just outside off. Ravindra has a big swish at it and only grabs a handful of fresh air. More seam movement for Archer!
peach! Back of a length in the channel and this decks away sharply after pitching. Ravindra goes feeling for it and is beaten all ends up
back of a length on middle and leg. Ravindra gets up on his toes and drops it into the off side with soft hands
